row.title: A PR that deploys the tick Worker needs a verify line
row.body: Hosted CI failed ORCHESTRATE-1 on the check 'deploys ultrastable-tick with no verify line'. The tick /health carries ok, org, last_tick, cutover and ignition and no executor field, so the Handoff block reads steps_total, which shows the redeploy and a completed tick. A live reading of orch_runs needs its own endpoint; OL-20261126-1 carries it. Live ticks also skip the execute step while the cost level is in breach. (Claude-Session: session_0156nqDsC5ZesQCbC7qUmBkN)
